about: Which real repositories each role may be used for (docs/plans/plateau.md). tuning: looked at to find gaps and design fixes. held_out: never looked at while designing a fix; used only to check that a fix generalises. sealed: kept for the final release check, used for nothing else. A repo moves from held_out to tuning only by decision, and is then replaced in held_out. seen_held_out: repos that revealed a problem on a held-out run; still used to confirm that fix, but no longer independent evidence for it, so a fresh held-out repo checks it too.

seen_held_out.django: round 2: showed unique-name edges lost on attribute receivers (obj.query.m()); used again to check the fix

seen_held_out.npm: round 2: showed the static-method unique-name regression; used again to check its fix

seen_held_out.curl: round 2: showed conditions set only by the build configuration (generated config header, -D flags); used again to check the compile_commands fix, no longer an independent test of it
seen_held_out.redis: round 2: same, plus the <assert.h> resolution bug
